limits: Normal direct CFG only, no exception-unwind propagation
No indirect tail branches in selected functions; no indirect call target equivalence
Matching content/identity is not timing or layout equivalence
No inferred load width for ADD-produced pointers; only NUL prefix or named-object identity
Association means at least one classified use, not all uses of a definition
Stack spill/reload values and exception landing-pad entry states are not modeled
